title: Route151 CARLA-native glare severity after the exact ORION pixel pipeline

authorization_basis.user_instruction: 以后无需我审计，预实验可以直接开始
authorization_basis.interpretation: This CPU-only, outcome-blind check may verify that the already frozen renderer severities survive the ORION image pipeline.
does_not_authorize: adapter training or checkpoint selection with native glare
a VLM, UQ, task-degradation, TTC, collision, or safety claim

pipeline: OpenCV JPEG quality 20 encode/decode from team_code/orion_b2d_agent.py
NormalizeMultiviewImage with frozen RGB mean and standard deviation
PadMultiViewImage divisor 32, which is a no-op at 640x640

repository_transform_equivalence.assertion: The lightweight analyzer output is elementwise identical to the repository inference transforms for a deterministic synthetic frame.

limitations: The fixed mapped ROI is not a projected pedestrian or hazard bounding box.
Mapped ROI contrast does not decrease; only tensor impact and edge-loss ordering are established.
The effect remains a combined low-sun, exposure, bloom, lens-flare and atmospheric-veiling condition rather than an isolated optical ghost-flare attribution.
Five pose-matched frames do not establish continuous same-tick temporal coherence on an independent route.

analysis_time_provenance.binding: Recorded inside the immutable analysis report before the later exact-tensor diagnostic capture change; the Q20 implementation used by this analysis is therefore not silently rebound to the newer agent file.

next_gate.required_action: After explicit Route203 glare v3 authorization, run the already frozen same-tick clean/medium/heavy independent-route visual confirmation.

claim_boundary: This confirms severity ordering after the exact ORION pixel pipeline only. It does not show that glare degrades ORION, that the adapter detects glare, or that uncertainty-aware behavior improves driving safety.
